aspectRatio.zh-CN: 固定的裁切框宽高比；加载后改变时，裁切框按新比例重排。
aspectRatio.en-US: Fixed aspect ratio of the crop box. When it changes after loading, the box is laid out again at the new ratio.

cropperBoxCls.en-US: Class name of the crop box.

cropperBoxStyle.en-US: Style string of the crop box.

defaultAspectRatio.zh-CN: 裁切框的初始宽高比，拖动时会随之变化。
defaultAspectRatio.en-US: Initial aspect ratio of the crop box, which changes while dragging.

fill.zh-CN: 裁切结果中非图片部分的填充色。
fill.en-US: Fill color of the parts of the result that are not the image.

imgProps.zh-CN: 传给被裁切图片 img 标签的属性。src 与布局样式由组件决定，class 与 style 和组件自身的合并，onload 在组件处理完成后调用；alt 默认为空字符串，crossorigin 默认为 anonymous，均可覆盖。
imgProps.en-US: Attributes passed to the img element being cropped. src and the layout style belong to the component; class and style are merged with its own, and onload is called after the component has handled it. alt defaults to an empty string and crossorigin to anonymous; both can be overridden.

onZoomChange.zh-CN: 滚轮缩放时调用，参数为新的缩放比例。
onZoomChange.en-US: Called by wheel zooming, with the new zoom.

preview.zh-CN: 返回预览容器 DOM 的函数，裁切效果会实时镜像到该容器；可返回 null，表示容器尚未挂载。
preview.en-US: Function returning the DOM element that mirrors the cropped area live. It may return null while the element is not mounted yet.

rotate.zh-CN: 图片旋转角度，单向绑定，组件不会改变它。
rotate.en-US: Image rotation angle. It is one-way: the component never changes it.

showResizeBox.zh-CN: 是否展示裁切框边角的调整块。
showResizeBox.en-US: Whether to show the resize handles on the corners of the crop box.

src.en-US: Address of the image to crop.

zoom.zh-CN: 缩放比例，叠加在图片适应裁切区域的初始缩放之上；可用 `bind:zoom`、函数绑定或单向传值，滚轮缩放时更新绑定值并调用 `onZoomChange`。
zoom.en-US: Zoom, applied on top of the initial scaling that fits the image into the cropper; use `bind:zoom`, a function binding or a one-way value. Wheel zooming updates the bound value and calls `onZoomChange`.

getCropperCanvas.zh-CN: 按图片原始分辨率，把裁切框内的区域绘制到新的 canvas 并返回；图片加载前调用会抛出错误。
getCropperCanvas.en-US: Draws the area inside the crop box at the image's own resolution onto a new canvas and returns it. It throws when called before the image has loaded.
